tiles.name: The Subway Stair
tiles.note: You come down here from the drowned square: the stair is on the north wall (the map's edge). Water drips down it after you. Nothing that lives down here comes into this room.

tiles.name: The Chimney
tiles.note: The end of the Deep: a natural shaft goes straight up out of the south wall. Far up there's a round of light, a manhole, and a streetlight's glow. You can't climb it bare-handed. You can with a rope.

tiles.name: Foundry Street
tiles.note: The station: a platform either side of the flooded track, tiled walls, benches facing the rails. The lamps still flicker. Nobody has waited here for a long time.

tiles.name: Foundry Street
tiles.note: The dead train, standing at the platform with its doors shut and its windows black. There's room to squeeze between the cars.
The tunnel: rails under ankle-deep water, cables along the wall, a dead lamp every so often. It runs further than your torch.
A signal cabinet set into the tunnel wall, its door hanging open, its lamp dead.
One car on its own in the tunnel, a long way from the train it came off. There's room to get past it along the wall.
A staff door in the tunnel wall, a step up off the track.

tiles.name: The Ticket Hall
tiles.note: The ticket hall: the booth with its shutter down, a line of turnstiles, a clock stopped at twenty past four.
A side hall of the station: two tiled pillars, a gate line, a map of a line that doesn't go anywhere you know.
A tiled passage down to the platforms. The signs still point the way.
The passage turns. A poster nobody can read any more.

tiles.name: Staff Room
tiles.note: The staff room: lockers, a table, two chairs pushed back as if the shift just ended. A rota on the board with nobody's name crossed off.

tiles.name: Plant Room
tiles.note: The station's plant room: switchgear in a row, cable drums, a warning on the door. Everything is dead.

tiles.name: Stores
tiles.note: The stores: shelving along the walls, crates of spare signal parts, a mop in a bucket gone dry.

tiles.name: The Breach
tiles.note: The far wall of the station gave way here. Tiled floor up to a heap of rubble, and past it raw rock and a smell of wet stone. The survey team went through: their lamp is still on.
A service corridor that ends in rock: the tiles stop and the cave begins.
A rock chamber, bigger than your light. Stalagmites, wet stone, the drip of water somewhere.
A chamber held up on columns of stone where the stalactites met the floor.

tiles.name: The Cathedral
tiles.note: A cavern so tall your beam doesn't find the roof. Stalagmites as tall as you, a mound of fallen rock in the middle you can climb.

tiles.name: Survey Camp
tiles.note: Async's survey team camped here: work lights still on, crates, a table of maps gone to pulp. They left in a hurry.

tiles.name: The Terraces
tiles.note: A cavern in steps: a sunken bowl in the middle. Go off the north ledge and you'll land fine — you won't get back up it. The slope round the south side is the way back.
A rock shelf up one side of the chamber. A slope climbs to it; the edge drops straight back down.
An underground river, ankle-deep and fast, cold enough to hurt. It's loud. So are you, in it.
The river runs shallow over a shelf of rock here. Stepping stones, if you trust them.
The river turning a corner, cutting under the rock.

tiles.name: The Chasm
tiles.note: The cave splits open here. A drop nobody walks away from, and one way across: a walk of planks somebody laid on a spine of rock.
A length of subway tunnel that went the wrong way into the rock. The tiles stop mid-wall.
A narrow passage, your shoulders brushing rock. The walls click now and then. Rock settling, probably.
A long narrow passage. You can't see the end of it and you can't turn round in it either.
The passage turns.
Two passages meet. Listen before you pick one.
Four ways into the rock.
The passage opens for a few steps into a little chamber. Open rock. Whatever lives in the walls doesn't come out here.
A crawlspace. The roof comes down to meet you; you go through on your knees, or not at all.

tiles.name: The Squeeze
tiles.note: The longest crawl in the Deep. Halfway along you'll hear it, and you'll be on your knees when you do.
A crawlspace bending round a corner of rock.
A small open chamber, room to stand. The clicking stops at the edge of it.

tiles.name: The Hollow
tiles.note: A wide low hollow in the Deep, the only room down here to breathe. Survey chalk on the walls: arrows, and a count of days that stops.
The cave drops away under a crack in the Deep. Planks across it, and nothing under the planks for a long way.
